name: Six Stars End
source:
You're Kryzz, a shut-in with zero offline friends and a decade of digital isolation. But you're done with that life. It's time to take back the happiness you left behind – and maybe the rest of the world with it.

[From [url=https://laurelalloro.itch.io/six-stars-end]Itch.io[/url]]
